annotations.title: Scan CVE Vulnerabilities, CISA KEV & EPSS Exploit Scores

description: Correlate Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs) against the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, FIRST.org 30-day Exploit Prediction Scoring System (EPSS) probabilities, and NVD CVSS v3 severity metrics.

cveIds.description: Optional list of specific CVE identifiers (e.g., ["CVE-2024-3094", "CVE-2023-44487"]). Leave empty to scan latest CISA KEV additions.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of prioritized vulnerability records to return.

minEpssScore.description: Minimum 30-day FIRST.org EPSS exploitation probability between 0.0 and 1.0.

name: scan_cve_kev_epss_vulnerabilities
